trap.label: how long
trap.wrong: How much time do you study English?
trap.right: How long have you studied English?
trap.why: Em português 'há quanto tempo' vira how long + present perfect; o aluno traduz com 'quanto tempo' no presente.

fix.right: How long have you been here?

fix.wrong: I have studied English since five years.
fix.right: I have studied English for five years.

rewrite.answer: How long has he lived here?

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I started in March. I'm still here.” com since
rewrite.answer: I have been here since March.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com for: “I started waiting four hours ago and I'm still waiting.”
rewrite.answer: I have waited for four hours.
